```yaml
name: Merge dev into features/hubs-recs

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - dev
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  merge:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository (dev)
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: dev

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Fetch all branches
        run: git fetch --all

      - name: Checkout or create features/hubs-recs
        run: |
          if git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/heads/features/hubs-recs; then
            git checkout features/hubs-recs
          else
            git checkout -b features/hubs-recs
          fi

      - name: Merge dev into features/hubs-recs
        run: |
          git merge dev --no-ff -m "Merge dev into features/hubs-recs"
          if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "Merge conflicts detected. Aborting."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Push updated features/hubs-recs
        run: git push origin features/hubs-recs

  build:
    needs: merge
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout features/hubs-recs
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: features/hubs-recs

      - name: Set up PowerShell
        uses: actions/setup-powershell@v1

      - name: Run build
        run: pwsh -Command "Write-Host 'Build placeholder for features/hubs-recs'"
```
